heading: Work on real projects in Chamba.
subheading: The Business Development programme includes a three-month internship on one of four venture areas connected to Chamba. Participants work on defined business tasks, receive guidance and build a record of practical work.

ventures.title: Chamba Rumal & Heritage Apparel
ventures.status: Brand and product development in progress
ventures.description: Work with local artisans to explore contemporary products that use Chamba Rumal embroidery. The product direction may include embroidered T-shirts and shirts, followed by Chamba chappal, wool coats and other locally rooted apparel/accessories.
ventures.accuracyNote: Do not show a mock-up as a product already available for purchase. Use actual product photographs only when the product exists and the relevant artisan/owner has consented to publication.

ventures.title: Chamba Travel & Experiences
ventures.status: Network and service model in development
ventures.description: Develop a local chain of hospitality and visitor experiences around Chamba. The idea includes local guiding, homestay/B&B operations, property presentation, customer acquisition and experiences that help visitors connect with the area.
ventures.accuracyNote: This is an experience model being developed. Synapse does not currently operate an existing commercial hotel or booking engine.

ventures.title: Synapse Education
ventures.status: Current education brand; expansion planned across Himachal Pradesh
ventures.description: Support the education operation and its growth: teaching assistance, organising batches, student onboarding, school/college outreach, event coordination and admissions support.
ventures.accuracyNote: Strong participants may be considered for future roles as centres expand, depending on business needs. A job is not guaranteed.

ventures.title: Chamba FMCG & Agro-Products
ventures.status: Concept and product definition in development
ventures.description: Explore a packaged consumer-products business using local produce and food traditions. Areas to research include Chamba apples, Chamba chukh, aam papad, local beans/rajma and Himalayan berries.
ventures.accuracyNote: This is a venture area being explored, not a claim that all listed products are currently packaged, certified or available for sale. Labeled in development.

cta.title: Want to work on one of these projects?
cta.description: The Business Development programme is open to students enrolled in a bachelor’s programme. Enquire to understand the six-month structure, available project areas, current batch and selection process.
